summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the LATEST feature changes: (1) multiple pedane with the SAME codice (posizione) now register without blocking, and (2) 'Tipo merce' field is persisted per pedana. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests PASS (6 new in test_merce_duplicate.py + 25 existing). New tests confirm: POST /api/pedane accepts 2 pedane with identical codice and different merce, each saved separately; GET /api/pedane?q=<merce text> finds by merce text (merce indexed in list search); GET /api/pedane/cerca?q=<codice> returns ALL pedane with that codice including merce; PUT /api/pedane/{id} updates merce; POST /api/import-pdf with the provided sample returns numeroOrdine 25023467 with 6 pedane NOT merged (short codes 2619-019320 x2, 2619-019318 x2, 2619-019321 x2) and each row carries mittente (ORCHIDEA / BERTOLI FRUIT / MORANDO GRAZIANO) + merce. Frontend (390x844 Expo web): login → ufficio OK; new order form: form-mittente-input DOES NOT exist (correct), each row has form-pedana-codice/mittente/destinazione/colli/merce-input-{i} testIDs; added 2 rows with the SAME codice, form-save-button succeeded WITHOUT any 'duplicata' blocking error (dup-sheet did not appear for a brand-new numeroOrdine, as expected) and both pedane visible in ufficio list showing merce text; edit of an existing pedana reloaded mittente + merce into row 0 correctly; Magazzino search by that posizione shows both results via magazzino-result-{codice} with merce visible on each; detail view renders pedana-detail-merce and pedana-detail-mittente with correct values. All TEST_* data cleaned up; office password remains antolini2024.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Likely from a shadow* StyleSheet prop; non-blocking but should migrate to boxShadow for RN web.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' from some RN component usage; non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate RN inline shadow* style props to style.boxShadow and move pointerEvents from prop into style, to silence deprecation warnings on RN Web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: list_pedane now includes 'merce' in the $or search fields — matches review request.
cerca endpoint uses exact codice match first and returns up to 100 rows → correctly returns all pedane sharing the same codice.
create_pedane creates one DB row per PedanaIn (no merging by codice), honoring the 'duplicate posizione allowed' requirement.
mittente fallback (p.mittente.strip() or f.mittente.strip()) preserved for backward compatibility, but form sends mittente='' in payloadForm so per-row mittente is authoritative — consistent with UI.
PDF import prompt updated to extract per-row mittente and merce, and short codice format NNNN-NNNNNN; verified via live Gemini call.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_merce_duplicate.py (new, 6 tests covering duplicate codice + merce + updated PDF import)
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_* and TPOS* data created during tests. All cleaned up via DELETE (2 leftover TEST pedane also cleaned at end). Office password remains antolini2024. Cooperativa setting cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://pedana-lookup.preview.emergentagent.com (env key EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Office pw: antolini2024. The role selection screen uses testIDs 'accesso-ufficio-button' and 'accesso-magazzino-button' (NOT 'role-ufficio-card'). PDF import now returns one row per PDF line; the Gemini-returned 'MORANDO GRAZIANO' may include a trailing suffix (observed 'MORANDO GRAZIANO S.R'), so use substring assertions, not equality. For buttons inside bottom sheets, use scroll_into_view_if_needed + dispatch_event('click'). PDF import takes ~10s via Gemini 3 Flash; use timeout>=90s.
